Synopsis:
This occurs in the DEN. The dead can be Kanon, Aradin or Zevlor. It is a recently made grave.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_KurwinCoffin_AD_GraveKurwin.json: Simple grave narration. In Act 1, you may have found a letter to Nine-Fingers on a courier note. The note said, 'If you want your money, dig up the grave of M Kurwin. That'll settle my debt.'
- LOW_KurwinCoffin_Gravekeeper.json: A weary gravekeeper, absolutely exhausted at having to bury so many bodies in recent days. Would be good to have her have typical gallows humour, but be relatively kindhearted and helpful underneath it (though relatively unimportant) She will exclusively hang around the gravekeeper's house, and likely either be found sat and resting or just idly milling around a small area.Important topics:- Where you can find a shovel- Killings in Baldur's Gate (with a branch for if it's solved)- (When you've encountered them) Kobold Looters- Something to chastise the player if they've gone around digging up graves themselves, probably a HasMet alt?
- DEN_General_Dead_Kanon.json: Kanon was manning the mechanism that opened the gate to the Druid Grove. He was trying to open the gate to let Aradin and the player through when he was killed by approaching goblins. Here, the player is using the Speak With Dead spell on his corpse. He is ashamed that he was not able to open the gate, and believes that he's killed Aradin and the rest because of that failure. That said, he still speaks like a corpse - serious, detached, a bit spooky.
- LOW_KurwinCoffin_KoboldLooter.json: Automatically initiated dialogue after players bash/prise open a coffin with Bugthimble, a tetchy and mistrustful Kobold, just trying to live her best life looting the coffin and the nasty adventurers dug her upt! She wears a face covering helmet.Players have either dug here expecting to find "Enough valuables to settle matters between us" as the note they found said (Tough letter, found on the Courier by Scratch) or just decided to dig up a grave for fun.
- LOW_KurwinCoffin_PAD_MessyCorpse.json: The player has dug up a body that looks particularly messy/bloody/scarred. For anyone else, this is just a simple "Ew" moment to question why you're going digging.  But for the Dark urge, they remember and are happy with it, which prompts a PAD that follows this up.

- Player: Look around cautiously, then dig with your hands. (node 15)

context: You’re standing at a freshly turned grave in the Den — a very recent burial that the player has approached and started digging by hand. Depending on prior actions, you may have come here because a courier’s note ("dig up the grave of M. Kurwin") promised payment, or because you simply decided to exhume a body for curiosity or profit. The corpse interred can be Kanon (the gate operator who died trying to open the Druid Grove gate), Aradin, or Zevlor, and if you use Speak With Dead on Kanon he will speak in a serious, detached way and be ashamed he failed to open the gate. Optional off-screen elements: a weary gravekeeper may be nearby and likely to scold or joke about grave‑digging, a tetchy kobold looter (Bugthimble) might be rifling the coffin, and a particularly messy corpse can trigger Dark Urge–specific reactions. These sequences are examples of possible outcomes, not the only ones.
